# For seamless AAC concatenation<AvailableFrom v="4.0.123" />

If enabled, the audio is trimmed to the nearest AAC frame, which is required for seamless concatenation of AAC files. This is a requirement if you later want to combine multiple video snippets seamlessly.<br /><br /> See [Distributed rendering](/docs/distributed-rendering) and [`combineChunks()`](/docs/renderer/combine-chunks) for how to concatenate the chunks.

## CLI flag

```text
--for-seamless-aac-concatenation
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)
- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderFrames()`](/docs/renderer/render-frames#forseamlessaacconcatenation)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#forseamlessaacconcatenation)
- [`stitchFramesToVideo()`](/docs/renderer/stitch-frames-to-video#forseamlessaacconcatenation)
- [`renderMediaOnVercel()`](/docs/vercel/render-media-on-vercel#forseamlessaacconcatenation)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setForSeamlessAacConcatenation(true);
```
